ambient_events: Somewhere inside the decks a carousel turns with a long hydraulic groan and stops.
A small VTOL drops onto the roof pad and its rotors wind down.
The lift tower's red light blinks on top.
description: Five open decks of grey precast on Marrow Street, between Higher Purchase and The Flute, with small aircraft parked on every one behind a steel mesh. A steel lift tower runs up the north-east corner to a landing pad on the roof. STACKED DECK is lit in blue over the door, and a board under it says VTOL PARKING: FREE.
name: Marrow Street Parking
